_doc: Manual corrections of the defensive line per formation segment (World Cup pipeline).
Each override matches one segment by game_id, team (name), period and start_s (seconds since
period start, +-15 s tolerance; the build summary prints these values for every segment).
back_line lists player ids from right to left (3, 4 or 5 ids). Slots: 3 -> right-centre, centre,
left-centre; 4 -> right, right-centre, left-centre, left; 5 -> right, right-centre, centre,
left-centre, left. 'reason' is free text for the record.
